description: This file defines the implementation of an uplink processor for a radio communication system, including classes for processing uplink PDUs, managing task execution, and interfacing with various physical layer components such as PRACH, PUSCH, PUCCH, and SRS. It also includes a notifier adaptor class for handling PUSCH result notifications.

classes.name: pusch_processor_result_notifier_adaptor
classes.description: Adapts the PUSCH processor result notifier to the upper PHY receive results notifier, handling control and data results.

classes.name: uplink_processor_impl
classes.description: Implements the uplink processing logic, managing PDUs, processing symbols, and interfacing with physical layer components.

methods.name: configure
methods.description: Configures the notifier adaptor with the upper PHY notifier, RNTI, slot, HARQ ID, payload, and callback.

methods.name: on_uci
methods.description: Handles UCI (control) results from the PUSCH processor, notifying the upper layer.

methods.name: on_sch
methods.description: Handles SCH (data) results from the PUSCH processor, notifying the upper layer and executing callback.

methods.name: get_pdu_slot_repository
methods.description: Returns the PDU slot repository for a given slot.

methods.name: get_slot_processor
methods.description: Returns the slot processor for a given slot.

methods.name: handle_rx_symbol
methods.description: Processes received symbols at the end of a symbol index.

methods.name: process_symbol_pdus
methods.description: Processes PDUs associated with received symbols up to a given end symbol index.

methods.name: notify_discard_pusch
methods.description: Notifies the discard of a PUSCH reception.

methods.name: notify_discard_pucch
methods.description: Notifies the discard of a PUCCH reception.

methods.name: notify_discard_pucch
methods.description: Notifies the discard of a PUCCH Format 1 collection.
